name: cherry-assets
description: TypeScript toolchain for Cherry's client-side islands (compiled JS ships with themes; user sites stay node-free).

scripts.build: esbuild assets/js/theme-toggle.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=priv/themes/default/assets/theme-toggle.js && esbuild assets/js/theme-toggle.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=priv/themes/cherrybomb/assets/theme-toggle.js && esbuild assets/js/copy-code.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=priv/themes/default/assets/copy-code.js && esbuild assets/js/copy-code.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=priv/themes/cherrybomb/assets/copy-code.js && esbuild assets/js/livereload.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=priv/serve/livereload.js && esbuild assets/js/search.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=priv/search/search.js
